fullDaySay: You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 20s, with a shaved head telling A man, maybe 30s about A person, maybe 40s. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
💧 A person, maybe 40s returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 A person, maybe 20s returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with tattooed arms returns with water: +3 clean.
"Hey." A woman, maybe 30s settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A woman, maybe 30s.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A woman, maybe 40s came back with 652 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
Somchai and Tariq lingered over the fire together.
You remember the Sling at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
You remember the Work Gloves at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
🔧 Technique learned: tick removal.
A person, maybe 30s, with tattooed arms watches you scratch at your ankle and shakes their head. “Here — tweezers at the head, steady pull, don’t twist. Like this.” (You learned tick removal.)
— DAY 2 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.

👀 the person in their 30s, with tattooed arms, the surgeon was talking about home — then stopped mid-sentence, recalibrated, and said "Denver" just a fraction too deliberately. Whatever home is, it isn't where that sentence started.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A person, maybe 30s, with tattooed arms).
Renee Sandoval reads the sky: rain tomorrow, cold.
A woman, maybe 20s will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
You step into the Haven hall.
A person, maybe 20s looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
📋 A person, maybe 30s, with tattooed arms — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
A person, maybe 20s shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 50s looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 20s, with a gap-toothed grin shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
📋 A woman, maybe 40s — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
(Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 30s speaks 🇹🇭 Thai. You share no language at all.
They point at themself and say it slowly, twice. It sounds like a name: Somchai.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Somchai).
Somchai speaks only 🇹🇭 Thai. No shared words at all — just eyes, hands, and patience.
"Ingrid," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Ingrid." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Ingrid).
"Lillian," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Lillian." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Lillian).
You eat Dried meat and Trail mix (1400 kcal).
You take 4 logs from the woodpile for the road home. (11 left for the hearth.)

"Tariq," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Tariq." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Tariq).

Travel 1 tile to grove.
— Nut trees —
Bark stripped at deer height on a young hickory — teeth, winter, hunger. Somebody winters here. Maybe you will too.
Something big is moving in the woods. The birds went quiet.
You see smoke on the horizon. Stonebridge — 9 people, 3 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 4 plants — 4 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
You catch fragments by the fire — Lillian telling A man, maybe 20s, with a shaved head about A person, maybe 50s. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
📖 LEARNED: Gossip Network (Level 1). You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.
You catch fragments by the fire — Lillian telling A person, maybe 50s about A man, maybe 20s, with a shaved head. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 50s telling Ingrid about Lillian. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
Unfamiliar unknown shoots — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
Journal: Mast country. The old trees feed everything.
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND **Green Thumb, Literally**. It resonates with: something unnamed, something unnamed.
A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 4× unknown shoots. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
1 unprocessed haul onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
Someone by the fire nods at the counter. "We pool food here. Keep what you need for the road — the rest feeds everyone, once it's food."
Nobody at the fire knows your haul any better than you do. It'll be your own hands that teach you.
You walk back into Haven. 4 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
Zoe picks through the bag, frowning. Nothing they can name with confidence. (8 ticks)

💧 Tariq returns with water: +2 clean.
📣 A man, maybe 20s, with a shaved head found a cache out there — enough to matter.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the south called Thornfield. The region is bigger than your fire.
Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.

A person, maybe 50s is showing everyone a sprawling vine with heart-shaped leaves and sweet orange-fleshed tubers by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The journal grows — the human way.
★ IDENTIFIED: Sweet Potato. Vine, orange tubers, sweet. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
You were listening. Now you know Sweet Potato too.

A woman, maybe 30s spends the afternoon with the vine with thick-skinned round fruit — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.
From the lumped bag: Muscadine Grapes — named, and out.
★ IDENTIFIED: Muscadine Grapes. Muscadine. Thick-skinned wild grapes. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
💡 The vine with thick-skinned round fruit — THAT's what A woman, maybe 30s was describing. Muscadine Grapes. It clicks like a key turning.
Lillian was watching. Now they know Muscadine Grapes too.
A person, maybe 30s, with tattooed arms traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
Lena and Tariq lingered over the fire together.
🤢 Desmond's stomach knots — something in their meal was off.
Luis and Renee lingered over the fire together.
🍽️ Somchai carries the day's surplus to the pantry door, thinks better of it, and turns back to the fire. "It'll only rot in there. We eat."

Fresh-cut stems on the east ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (Stonebridge's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)

— Under the canopy —
Leaf litter, birdcall, the smell of rot becoming soil. The woods, being the woods.
Movement — a bobcat, tufted ears, watching you with yellow eyes.
👁 It is hunting you. Don't run — that invites the chase. Hold your ground, strike true, or wear the claws.
Nothing left to take here today.
